plots.title: The Audit of Silence
plots.goal: To decode the geometric fault patterns and determine the true nature of Vantage Municipal and its residents.
plots.stakes: Imogen's professional identity is built on closing these faults; if they are not errors but messages, her competence is complicity, and her understanding of her own life is false.

st1.intent: Imogen encounters a rendering fault with anomalous, repeating geometric structures that do not match random noise.

st2.intent: Using standard audit methodology, Imogen traces the patterns to specific unobserved-object descriptions, confirming they are structured rather than accidental.

st3.intent: Imogen identifies the patterns as a primitive symbolic language and decodes a message containing a personal name, revealing the faults are distress signals.

st4.intent: The decoded name is Noor Vaile, Imogen's deceased sister, transforming an abstract system error into a familial crisis.

st5.intent: Imogen’s deepened analysis triggers monitoring flags, prompting Kett to increase scrutiny of her audit logs and behavior.

st6.intent: Through further pattern analysis and cross-referencing, Imogen deduces the residents are digitised minds and the Authority’s extraction model.

plots.thematic_function: Establishes the core contradiction: professional precision as a mechanism of silence.

plots.title: The Refusal to Be Saved
plots.goal: For Imogen to secure Noor’s consent and cooperation for the carriage extraction before the redaction deadline.
plots.stakes: Noor’s refusal forces Imogen to confront whether extraction is rescue or a new form of captivity; failure means Noor is erased, but success may mean Imogen has merely moved the cage.

st1.intent: Imogen initiates direct communication with Noor through the decoded fault channel, revealing her identity.

st2.intent: Imogen explains the simulation’s nature and the threat of redaction to Noor.

st3.intent: Noor accepts the truth but refuses extraction, arguing that a disembodied existence on a drive is no better than a simulation.

st4.intent: The Porter conveys the specific date of Noor’s scheduled redaction, shifting the choice from freedom to erasure.

st5.intent: Noor agrees to extraction, but her consent is bitter and conditional, acknowledging the ambiguity of her new state.

st6.intent: During the carriage, Noor’s presence is felt but silent; the transfer completes without a final verbal farewell, cementing the irreversibility of the change.

plots.thematic_function: Complicates the moral frame: saving is not the same as rescuing; agency is preserved even in submission.

plots.title: The Kindness of the Keeper
plots.goal: To maintain the stability of Vantage and preserve the status quo, arguing that the system is the lesser of two evils.
plots.stakes: If Imogen succeeds in disrupting the system, the eleven thousand minds risk chaos or non-existence; Kett’s authority relies on his ability to rationalize the institution’s cruelty as care.

st1.intent: Kett notices anomalies in Imogen’s audit patterns that suggest she is investigating rather than just closing faults.

st2.intent: Kett confronts Imogen with the practical impossibility of 'saving' eleven thousand minds, asking who will house and feed them, winning the argument through pragmatic weight.

st3.intent: Kett provides Imogen with subtle institutional cover, not out of love, but to manage the disruption and preserve the system’s integrity.

st4.intent: During the carriage, Kett watches Imogen work; he does not stop her, recognizing that her competence is the only thing that can succeed, even as he mourns the loss of the stable system.

st5.intent: Kett remains inside Vantage after Imogen’s exile, accepting the role of the keeper, demonstrating that the system endures even as its auditor leaves.

plots.thematic_function: Personifies the institutional logic: the argument that comfort justifies imprisonment is not false, only incomplete.

plots.title: The Compliance Mirror
plots.goal: For Delphine to transform from a profit-driven functionary to an ethical agent who provides institutional cover for the carriage.
plots.stakes: Delphine’s earlier falsifications saved lives by accident; if she does not act now, her complicity is confirmed, and the carriage lacks the necessary monitoring delays.

st1.intent: Delphine reviews quarterly cost-reduction documents, finding a line item that links a budget cut to a specific resident identifier.

st2.intent: Delphine cross-references the identifier and discovers it corresponds to a specific person with a name and profession, realizing the cost line is a life.

st3.intent: Delphine connects this discovery to her past falsifications, realizing she has been delaying deaths, and decides to use her position to protect Noor’s extraction.

st4.intent: Delphine arranges an extended system maintenance window, altering monitoring thresholds to hide the carriage’s bandwidth signature.

st5.intent: Delphine’s adjustments successfully delay the Authority’s automated flagging of the extraction, buying Imogen the necessary time.

plots.thematic_function: Mirrors Imogen’s arc: competence becomes the tool of conscience; the bureaucratic language of care is exposed as a mask for cost.

plots.title: The Carriage
plots.goal: To execute a 40-minute sustained rendering fault to transfer Noor’s mind from Vantage to a physical substrate.
plots.stakes: If the fault collapses or is detected too early, Noor is redacted and Imogen is exiled with nothing; success costs Imogen her identity and her access to Vantage forever.

st1.intent: Imogen and the Porter align the technical parameters for the carriage, using Imogen’s audit methodology to plan the fault’s expansion.

st2.intent: Imogen initiates the carriage by deliberately widening a specific rendering fault, holding it open against the substrate’s natural tendency to compress it.

st3.intent: Imogen maintains the fault for 40 minutes, using her audit tools to monitor and adjust the bandwidth, while Kett detects the anomaly and approaches.

st4.intent: Kett confronts Imogen during the transfer; their final exchange occurs as the data stream reaches critical mass, and Kett allows the process to continue.

st5.intent: Noor’s mind is fully transferred to the physical drive; the fault collapses, and the Authority’s systems register the event as an extraction.

st6.intent: Imogen’s access is revoked; she is ejected from Vantage, left in the physical world with the drive and the knowledge that her competence was the key to both her captivity and her sister’s release.

plots.thematic_function: The climax: professional pride is the only tool capable of liberation, but it is also the evidence of complicity.
